parties: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited (acquirer) | CESC Limited (target)
headline: Dotex Merchandise Disclosure: Substantial Acquisition of CESC Limited Shares
sum: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition event in CESC Limited. The filing indicates a shareholding milestone trigger that requires open offer and regulatory disclosure obligations.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures mark the onset of open offer and shareholding transparency obligations; counsel must verify whether the acquisition crossed 26% (presumption of control) or 59% (mandatory open offer floor) thresholds and review all conditions precedent to irrevocable obligation.
detail: Dotex Merchandise Private Limited submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE. This regulation requires disclosure when a person acquires shares such that voting rights cross specified thresholds (25%, 35%, 55% or 90%), triggering mandatory open offer obligations unless an exemption applies. The filing records the acquirer's shareholding, acquisition history, and irrevocable commitment to the open offer process.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Central: mandates disclosure of acquisition details and shareholding pattern to the stock exchange within 2 trading days of crossing a control threshold.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, Regulation 4 & Schedule I
framework.note: Central: defines triggering events for mandatory open offers (25%, 35%, 55%, 90% shareholding thresholds) and exemptions.
Central: defines 'person acting in concert' and attribution rules affecting consolidation of shareholding.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 37
framework.note: Procedural: sets timeline for open offer closure, acceptance and settlement procedures.
Ancillary: company law foundation for shareholder rights and disclosure obligations in acquisition transactions.
Procedural: mandates appointment of merchant banker and disclosure of financing arrangements for open offers.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, Section 2.1
framework.note: Ancillary: relevant if consideration includes issuance of securities by CESC or acquirer.

conditions: Crossing of shareholding threshold triggering open offer obligation under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 4
Merchant banker appointment for management of open offer process
Irrevocable commitment to open offer at prescribed consideration price
approvals: NSE filing and acceptance of Regulation 31(4) disclosure
SEBI review and approval of open offer notice (if not exempt under Regulation 5-9)
Stock exchange clearance for open offer commencement
structure.novel: No novel structure identified; standard substantial acquisition triggering mandatory open offer under extant SEBI framework.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
triggers.note: Acquisition event crossing 25%, 35%, 55%, or 90% shareholding thresholds triggers mandatory disclosure, open offer and potential exemption review under Regulations 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9.
Stock exchange rules govern filing timelines, merchant banker appointment, and offer period mechanics post-disclosure.
